failure_reason: Worker exhausted tiers 1-2 (Akamai blocks direct HTTP and Playwright/CDP on all inner pages, see prior notes) and could not use tier 3 due to a browser-selection step unavailable to a dispatched worker. Orchestrator follow-up pass used Claude-in-Chrome directly (with the browser-selection step) and found Costco.com is NOT uniformly blocked at tier 3: the homepage and static department landing pages (e.g. /furniture.html) render fully and normally. However /whats-new.html specifically still serves the Akamai 'Powered and protected by' challenge wall even via a real interactive browser. The site's only two nav entries resembling Clearance/New-Arrivals ('What's New' and 'While Supplies Last', top banner) both route to generic keyword-search result pages (/s?keyword=fallsavings and /s?keyword=whilesupplieslast&dept=All&COSTID=WSL_Homepage respectively) mixing all departments (electronics, toys, clothing, jewelry, etc.), not a standalone Clearance/New-Arrivals PLP with its own URL. 'While Supplies Last' returned 121 total results (Furniture:1, Home & Kitchen:18 facet counts) - a genuine backend-tagged campaign (COSTID tracking param, not literal free-text search) but with no stable per-facet count achievable via a bookmarkable URL, and no way to isolate a clean home-decor-only subset the way this project's Clearance rows require.
notes: No genuine Clearance PLP confirmed.
